screen.voidtree.title: Void Skill Tree
screen.voidtree.click_select: Click: select, then click a slot below (or press 1-4)
screen.voidtree.hint: Left click: unlock / select  •  Right click slot: clear  •  Hover + 1-4: assign
msg.voidtree.locked: Unlock one of the connected skills first.
item.voidtree.void_grimoire.tip1: Right click: open the void tree
item.voidtree.void_grimoire.tip2: Carried in hotbar or offhand: essence costs -20%
skill.voidtree.shadow_dash.desc: Dash up to 9 blocks as a shadow: 5 damage, blindness and slow to everything you pass; briefly invulnerable.
skill.voidtree.phantom_form.desc: 6s invisible and fast, monsters cannot target you. Your first hit deals 1.5x +6 damage and breaks the form.
skill.voidtree.void_mantle.desc: Passive: +50 max essence, faster regen. In darkness (light < 8) +20% damage and +50% regen. 15% chance to evade melee attacks.
skill.voidtree.void_vortex.desc: 5s vortex at the target point pulling enemies within 7 blocks to its centre, 2 damage every half second.
skill.voidtree.spirit_twister.desc: A spirit tornado travels 20 blocks forward, lifting and spinning enemies, 3 damage every half second.
skill.voidtree.shadow_claws.desc: 3 fast claw swipes in front of you (5 + 5 + 8 damage), wither, the last one knocks back.
skill.voidtree.soul_prison.desc: Locks the target in a starry void sphere for 4s: cannot move, 3 damage per second. Bosses are only slowed.
skill.voidtree.shadow_rain.desc: 16 shadow blades rain on the target area over 2.5s (5 damage + slow each).
skill.voidtree.black_hole.desc: 6s black hole swallowing enemies, items and projectiles within 10 blocks; collapses for 15 damage.
skill.voidtree.rift_walk.desc: Throw a rift and step through where it lands; it bursts for 8 damage. No fall damage.
skill.voidtree.ascension.desc: Fly for 15s with Resistance II and Regeneration, half skill costs, double essence regen.
skill.voidtree.void_seal.desc: 8s seal of 8 blocks around you: enemies slowed, weakened, 2 damage per second; hostile projectiles vanish, endermen cannot teleport.
skill.voidtree.shadow_clones.desc: Summon 3 shadow clones for 20s that hunt monsters and your target (6 damage) and burst when they fade.
skill.voidtree.cosmic_collapse.desc: Tear the sky open: stars fall on a 12 block area for 3.5s (6 damage), then everything inside takes an 18 damage collapse.
